messages.subject: Downloading an dataTableoutput as an xlsx table
parts:
Hello, my app is read to use as I am doing in a few days, but I can't download the output as a table, can someone help me, as you all already did in other ocasions?

https://jeguasselli.shinyapps.io/SimpleDEA - this is my app, and the table I want to download is what output$resumo generates.


output$resumo <- renderDataTable({
  objFile <- chooseFile()
  if (!is.null(objFile)) {
    suf <- objFile$suf
    # For Excel documents;
    if (suf %in% c('.xls', '.xlsx')) {
      Sheet <- input$sheet
      wb <- loadWorkbook(objFile$path)
      dat <- readWorksheet(wb, Sheet)
      
      if (input$model=="crs") {
        
        X <- data.frame(dat[c(input$columns)]) # input variable at second column of the data matrix
        Y <-data.frame(dat[c(input$colum)]) # output variables
        
        e <- dea(X, Y, RTS="crs", ORIENTATION="out", XREF=NULL, YREF=NULL,
                 FRONT.IDX=NULL, SLACK=TRUE, DUAL=FALSE, DIRECT=NULL, param=NULL,
                 TRANSPOSE=FALSE, FAST=FALSE, LP=TRUE, CONTROL=NULL, LPK=NULL)
        
        sl <- slack(X,Y,e)
        
        planilha <- cbind(dat[,1],sl$slack,sl$sx,sl$sy)
        rownames(planilha) <- dat[,1]
        colnames(planilha) <- c("DMU's","folga",names(X),names(Y))
        return(planilha)
        
        
      }
      if (input$model=="vrs") {
        
        X <- data.frame(dat[c(input$columns)]) # input variable at second column of the data matrix
        Y <-data.frame(dat[c(input$colum)]) # output variables
        
        e <- dea(X, Y, RTS="vrs", ORIENTATION="out", XREF=NULL, YREF=NULL,
                 FRONT.IDX=NULL, SLACK=TRUE, DUAL=FALSE, DIRECT=NULL, param=NULL,
                 TRANSPOSE=FALSE, FAST=FALSE, LP=TRUE, CONTROL=NULL, LPK=NULL)
        
        sl <- slack(X,Y,e)
        
        plani <- cbind(dat[,1],sl$slack,sl$sx,sl$sy)
        rownames(plani) <- dat[,1]
        colnames(plani) <- c("DMU's","folga",names(X),names(Y))
        return(plani)
        
        
      }
      
      if (input$model=="crsin") {
        X <- data.frame(dat[c(input$columns)]) # input variable at second column of the data matrix
        Y <-data.frame(dat[c(input$colum)]) # output variables
        
        e <- dea(X, Y, RTS="crs", ORIENTATION="in", XREF=NULL, YREF=NULL,
                 FRONT.IDX=NULL, SLACK=TRUE, DUAL=FALSE, DIRECT=NULL, param=NULL,
                 TRANSPOSE=FALSE, FAST=FALSE, LP=TRUE, CONTROL=NULL, LPK=NULL)
        
        sl <- slack(X,Y,e)
        
        planil <- cbind(dat[,1],sl$slack,sl$sx,sl$sy)
        rownames(planil) <- dat[,1]
        colnames(planil) <- c("DMU's","folga",names(X),names(Y))
        return(planil)
        
      }
      
      if (input$model=="vrsin") {
        
        X <- data.frame(dat[c(input$columns)]) # input variable at second column of the data matrix
        Y <-data.frame(dat[c(input$colum)]) # output variables
        
        e <- dea(X, Y, RTS="vrs", ORIENTATION="in", XREF=NULL, YREF=NULL,
                 FRONT.IDX=NULL, SLACK=TRUE, DUAL=FALSE, DIRECT=NULL, param=NULL,
                 TRANSPOSE=FALSE, FAST=FALSE, LP=TRUE, CONTROL=NULL, LPK=NULL)
        
        sl <- slack(X,Y,e)
        
        pla <- cbind(dat[,1],sl$slack,sl$sx,sl$sy)
        rownames(pla) <- dat[,1]
        colnames(pla) <- c("DMU's","folga",names(X),names(Y))
        return(pla)
        
      }
      
      
    }
    
  }else {return(NULL)}
  
})

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: Downloading an dataTableoutput as an xlsx table
parts:
To download from a Datatable, you can consider the tutorial: https://www.datatables.net/extensions/tabletools/

If it's too complicated, you can try another method: 
1. create a reactiveValues or reactive function
2. create a download handle
3. link the download handle to the result of reactive function.

parts:
It seems that the tabletops extension has been "retired". 

Have you considered using rhandsontable?

It is now on CRAN and has also downloading capabilities.
